action_summary: v15 regressed from 0.310 to 0.439 because the EEG ensembles (models_0 from new_distil+new_fold, models_1 from baseline_eeg_diff) were commented out and only the weaker spectrogram model was used. I re-enabled loading and inference for both EEG families in the v13 configuration (the best-scoring version, 0.30219) without the flip TTA that hurt in v14, and kept the spectrogram model as an additional diversity member. Predictions are now averaged within each family first, then blended with fixed family weights (0.40 EEG family 0, 0.40 EEG family 1, 0.20 spectrogram) so the weaker spectrogram branch cannot dominate. Added NaN/inf guarding on the spectrogram features and a small probability clip before renormalization for KL safety.
